evidence.reason: The polling loop accepts a drained result before checking the deadline and sleeps the full interval, so with a long drain interval a poll observed after expiry can break the loop and let the deploy proceed. This is an ordinary deadline-enforcement bug in the existing drain behavior; no owner judgment is needed for the minimal fix.
